_about: Compliance rules for the SonicWall EXP audit. Edit these values to match client policy; sonicwall_compare.py reads this file at runtime.
_trusted_zone_note: The main internal / trusted network. All inter-VLAN access is judged relative to this zone.
_trusted_zones_note: Zones treated as trusted user networks alongside the LAN. SSL VPN remote users land in SSLVPN and legitimately need to reach LAN servers/resources, so SSLVPN->LAN is allowed and NOT flagged. Any zone NOT in this list that reaches the LAN is a red flag. Management access is governed separately by management.admin_allowed_zones (LAN only) — being a trusted DATA zone does not grant firewall-management access.
_vpn_user_zones_note: Zones holding remote-access VPN USERS. Two rules apply: (1) VPN user-to-user traffic must be blocked (intra-zone communication off) to stop lateral movement between remote sessions; (2) the LAN must NOT initiate connections TO these zones (LAN->SSLVPN blocked) — remote users reach LAN servers, not the other way around.

lan_requirements._note: Content filtering and IPS/IDS are REQUIRED on the trusted LAN. Any VLAN/zone/interface allowed to talk INTO the LAN is a red flag.

ssh._note: SSH management must be enabled, may ONLY be reachable from the LAN zone, and must be restricted to at most 2 source IPs.

management.admin_source_description: the jumpbox that runs the Connect Secure agent
management._note: The admin interface (HTTPS/HTTP/SNMP) and SSH may ONLY be reachable from the LAN zone, and must be IP-restricted to at most max_source_ips. Every other zone — VPN, WAN, and all other VLANs — must be denied management access. To also permit IP-restricted WAN/GMS management, add "WAN" to admin_allowed_zones. Unrestricted (Any-source) management access is a red flag.

vpn._note: If SSL VPN is configured, DUO or Entra (SAML) MFA is REQUIRED. Directory should be AD/LDAP or Entra.

external_services._note: WAN-inbound services open to any source are red flags, except expected VPN listeners which must accept any remote IP.

consistency._note: Across all firewalls for one client, geo-blocking and blocked content-filter categories must match. If one firewall blocks something, they all must. The STRICTEST firewall (union of everything blocked) is the baseline; anything missing on a peer is an exception.
